svg.title: The localization error of a differentiated tensor is controlled at the actual stencil sites: (TF0b) uses only shifts of length at most four, so its error is bounded by P l|dl|(A+A) if the undifferentiated error is at most A. Summing the four directions gives four times this allowance. Support and anchor weights are enlarged by four at this step. The corresponding derivative and tail allowances are summed with the same absolute coefficients. Exponential path decay pays the discarded tails including their first moments; the stationary four-jet identity pays the local Taylor difference. These are the separate errors retained when the localized divergence is issued as a degree-five insertion.
